findings.problem: The same argument appears three times. To transfer a valuation fact from `((z.natAbs : ℕ) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ)` to `((z : ℤ) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ)`, each proof builds a `hcast : ((z.natAbs:ℕ):K) = ((z.natAbs:ℤ):K)`. It then splits with `rcases Int.natAbs_eq z` into the two sign cases and rewrites with `Int.cast_neg` and `Valuation.map_neg` in the negative case. The copies are at lines 103–108 (z = q.num, target value 1), 179–184 (z = q.num, target value v(r)^a) and 393–399 (z = (a:ℤ)-b, target value 1). Only the target value in `exact` differs.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma next to `vA_intCast_le_one`:

theorem vA_intCast_eq_natAbs (z : ℤ) : A.valuation (z : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) = A.valuation ((z.natAbs : ℕ) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ)

Proof sketch: `rcases Int.natAbs_eq z with hn | hn`, then `conv_lhs => rw [hn]`. In the first case use `Int.cast_natCast`. In the second case use `Int.cast_neg`, `Valuation.map_neg` and `Int.cast_natCast`.

The three uses then become one-line rewrites:
- `hvnum` in `den_coprime_of_vA_le_one`: `rw [vA_intCast_eq_natAbs]; exact vA_natCast_eq_one_of_coprime A hA hnum`.
- `hvnum` in `vA_ratCast_eq_zpow`: `rw [vA_intCast_eq_natAbs]; exact ha`.
- `h1` in `eq_of_varpi_dvd_sub`: `rw [vA_intCast_eq_natAbs]; exact vA_natCast_eq_one_of_not_dvd A hr hA hnd`.

The lemma needs no new imports or hypotheses, and each caller keeps its existing hypotheses. The `Valuation.map_neg` lemma it uses is already used in all three blocks.
findings.benefit: This removes about 15 lines of duplicated case analysis and cast bookkeeping. It states the fact "v(z) = v(|z|)" once, so a reader no longer has to re-check three near-identical blocks. A future change to the cast handling is made in one place.

Both then turn `(q - a) * q.den = r^N * w` into `q - a = r^N * w / q.den` with `eq_div_iff`. Finally they push the valuation through with the same long `rw` chain (`Rat.cast_div … map_div₀, map_mul, vA_natCast_eq_one_of_coprime … div_one`) and close with `mul_le_of_le_one_right zero_le' (vA_intCast_le_one A w)`. findings.proposed_change:
Reuse `net` in `exists_nat_lt_varpi_dvd_sub` and delete lines 353–364. After `hq1`, write:

obtain ⟨a, ha, hqa'⟩ := net A hr hA 0 1 q (by simpa using hq1)

This gives `a < r ^ (1 + 0)` and `A.valuation ((q - (a:ℚ)/(r:ℚ)^0 : ℚ) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ≤ A.valuation (r:AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ^ 1`. Normalize it with `pow_zero`, `div_one` and `pow_one`. Then get `hqa` from `v_ratCast`, `Rat.cast_sub` and `v_natCast`, relating `((q - a : ℚ) : Completion)` to `(q:Completion) - (a:Completion)`; `hc` already does this. The rest of the proof (`hax`, the final `dvd_of_le`) is unchanged.

All the hypotheses `net` needs are available here: `hr`, `hA` and `v(q) ≤ 1`. The `hq1` fact is proved just above. If `net`'s `(v r)⁻¹ ^ m` hypothesis form is awkward, factor the shared tail out instead. For example:

lemma vA_ratCast_sub_le (hr) (hA) {q : ℚ} {a N : ℕ} {w : ℤ} (hcop : q.den.Coprime r) (hw : ((q - a) * q.den : ℚ) = (r:ℚ)^N * w) : A.valuation ((q - a : ℚ) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ≤ A.valuation (r:AlgebraicClosure ℚ)^N

Then use it in both `net` (after its `key` rewrite) and `exists_nat_lt_varpi_dvd_sub`.
findings.benefit: It removes a second copy of the denominator-coprime / `Rat.cast` / valuation-of-quotient chain, which is the fragile part. The long `rw` lists no longer have to be kept in sync across two proofs. It also makes the link explicit: the residue-class step is the m = 0, n = 1 case of the general approximation lemma.
